data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'linarium', meaning 'lily'. Linaria symbolizes purity, grace, and enlightenment. In Christianity, the lily is a common symbol of the Virgin Mary and her immaculate conception. The name Linaria carries the meaning “Lily, Light” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Linaria usually hope their child will grow to embody lily, light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
